prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-screen game home screen prototype, landscape 16:9.
Create prototype 1 of 4: LEFT VERTICAL MENU.
The two provided reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their polished painterly fantasy mining game art, rich warm wood grain, brass riveted corner brackets, thin gold borders, warm amber selected buttons, cream serif lettering. Do not copy their shop/workbench grids or labels.
Scene: expansive OPEN cave landscape with a small tranquil cave lake visible in the middle/right, broad natural vaulted ceiling, layered rock formations, distant blue luminous crystals, a faint mine passage, warm lantern near menu, cool blue water reflecting crystals. Inviting mysterious atmosphere. Plenty of open space, not a cramped tunnel.
UI arrangement: narrow dark wooden menu panel on LEFT taking around 28% width, with brass corner fittings. A wooden logo plaque above it reading exactly "Mining Game". Four large vertically stacked buttons reading exactly "Fortsetzen", "Neues Spiel", "Einstellungen", "Beenden". Fortsetzen highlighted amber/gold. The entire RIGHT two thirds remains a beautiful unobstructed cave and lake vista. No large enclosing full-screen UI frame.
Motion-ready visual motifs represented in this still: sparse illuminated dust, subtle rings on lake from one droplet, small lantern flame, softly glowing crystal clusters. No drawn motion arrows or technical notes.
No other text, no subtitles, no help text, no HUD, no item cards, no people, no watermark. Crisp legible complete UI, professional game menu concept.

Use case: ui-mockup. Full screen 16:9 fantasy mining game home screen prototype 4 of 4.
